items.issue: test_snapshot_does_not_run_filter_from_any_source[global-clean|process] passes vacuously if the module drops GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL from its env: git never reads the global file, so the driver cannot run whatever the module does about filters. Close it by asserting an observable harmless global key survives the module env (core.excludesFile -> _assert_scratch_ignored).

items.issue: Every test in test_target_snapshot_programs.py asserts code == 0, so a compare that returns a constant unchanged report, reading neither repo nor snapshot, passes all of them; that also makes every compare-ran-the-program and assert_untouched(compare) assertion vacuous. Close it with one test that makes a real change after the snapshot (move a ref, edit a tracked file) and asserts code == 1 with the expected violation kind.

items.issue: Nothing asserts the snapshot config/index/gitdir content derives from the repository, so a snapshot freezing them to constants with gitdir = {} passes the clean-filter, fsmonitor and submodule-only tests and makes config rewrites and .git writes undetectable. Relatedly, _assert_submodule_head is satisfied by a submodule entry carrying only head.commit. Close it by asserting the config digest differs across two targets with different local config, that gitdir is non-empty, and that a submodule entry carries non-empty index/refs.
